label: UniFi G5 Bullet 2K camera
description: 4 MP (2K) UniFi Protect bullet with a 10/100 MbE RJ45 port, IP55 and IK04. PoE-powered, 4 W max, 37-57 VDC - an 802.3af load.
notes: PoE class 802.3af, 12.95 W reserved, 4 W drawn. Wired only, no Wi-Fi, and only a 10/100 port. Adopts only from a UniFi Protect controller - it will not talk ONVIF to a third-party NVR.
